Increment rescued count, read remaining big-endian time, and add remaining time times rescued count to total score. From rescue four onward set ant interval parameter sp=2+INT(sg/4).
At the ten-rescue goal show the medal and final event, pause 500 display frames, show restart prompt, wait for a key and RUN.
Continue at BASIC line 20 for the next rescue.
Read sixteen fields for each of eight objects into B480-B4FF, leaving fields with negative DATA unchanged. The records are player, companion, grenade and five ants.

Read 25 DATA fields into B420-B438, retaining entries whose DATA is negative.
Camera origin (185,237), view zero, the following nine fields set to one, and border/event fields set to zero.
Initialize grenade state, ammunition and both health bytes to twenty, time divider one, retain time bytes and set engine exit countdown one.
Return from runtime-state initialization.
Clear screen, set white city area and black border, construct the bitmap frame, print score and rescued total, and lay out the coloured ammunition/health/time/SCAN panel.
Print thirty-one solid block characters without a newline, then return.
Display the flashing retry message in the interlude area.
Show the title, poll ROM key numbers through USR 8090 and accept B=0 or G=6. Select BOY/GIRL labels and swap base shape numbers DC/6C at player and companion offsets 3.
Set engine countdown two and call 8000 to draw initial scene; show ready prompt and wait for a key. Clear prompt, call the engine again and return to BASIC when it exits.
Set B436/B437 to 03/E9, big-endian 1001. The ready pass decrements it before the visible ready prompt reads 1000.
Restore DATA for stage sg*10+1000, call its story text routine, apply the retry variant selector and read three bytes into the companion X/Y/Z.

Print the flashing prompt to press a key for a new game.
Print the ANT ATTACK logo as ROM block-graphic characters using colour variable ink. Its banner is authored BASIC string data, not a separate character set.
Draw publisher credit and Sandy White copyright, flash the block logo through colours five times while playing alternating low BEEPs, then play rising pitches 0..60 in steps of three and ask for G/B.

Print a flashing cyan score frame at BASIC variables x,y and put total score se inside it.

Enter the city engine with interrupts disabled. Print initial counters; repeatedly test key 1, run an update, test escape and failure, and decrement B438 unless it is FF.
